reason: I already get a dollar of Claude/GPT usage for about 1,600đ from a Telegram reseller, and you want 26,000đ for the same dollar. That is more than fifteen times what I pay now. Receipts and VAT invoices are nice, but not at that price for a small team like mine.
objection: The price. Also you don't list Claude, which is what I mostly use. And I've lost money before when a tool shut down, so a brand-new gateway has to prove it will still be around next year.
would_change_my_mind: If my reseller got cut off or a client insisted on a proper VAT invoice, I would take the 50,000đ free credit and test you. Even then I'd only move part of my usage over, and only if Claude were included.
